lines.t: Verse 1:
In the stillness You find me again,
When I’m lost, You whisper my name.
You lift the weight I could not bear,
Your love surrounds me everywhere.
Pre-Chorus:
When the world fades away and my strength is gone,
You hold me close and carry me on.
Chorus:
You are my Father, my friend,
Your mercy has no end.
In Your arms I’m safe, I’ll always belong,
My heart is Yours, my forever song.
My Father, my friend — faithful to the end.
Verse 2:
Through the valley, through the rain,
You’re the comfort in my pain.
Every breath, every tear I’ve cried,
You’re the comfort in my pain.
Every breath, every tear I’ve cried,
You’ve been right here by my side.
Pre-Chorus:
When I fall to my knees, You lift me high,
Your grace is the reason why.
Chorus:
You are my Father, my friend,
Your mercy has no end.
In Your arms I’m safe, I’ll always belong,
My heart is Yours, my forever song.
My Father, my friend — faithful to the end.
Bridge:
You are my shelter, You are my peace,
You are the love that will never cease.
From now till forever, I’ll praise Your name,
My Father, my friend — always the same.
Final Chorus (soft and full of emotion):
You are my Father, my friend,
Your mercy has no end.
Here in Your presence, I’ve found my place,
Eternal love, unending grace.
My Father, my friend — forever Amen.
